info.name: Gym Backend API
info.description:
HTTP collection for the gymBackend Express API.

Setup:
1. Select environment Gym Backend — Local (or set baseUrl).
2. Set email (+ lane CLIENT|STAFF and name for first-time users).
3. Run Auth > Email OTP > Request OTP — note isNewUser; paste OTP into otpToken.
4. Run Verify OTP (include lane only when isNewUser was true) — stores accessToken, refreshToken, userId.
5. Authenticated requests use collection Bearer {{accessToken}}.

Auth model:
- Public: /health, /auth/otp/request, /auth/otp/verify, /auth/refresh
- Bearer identity: /auth/google/complete
- Bearer provisioned: /auth/me, /gym-orgs/*

request.description:
POST /auth/otp/request — public. Sends a one-time code to the email and reports whether the client must collect lane.

**Request body (JSON):** `{ email: string }` only.

**Response type:** `application/json`
**Success:** `202`
```
{ status: "OTP_SENT", isNewUser: boolean }
```
- `isNewUser: true` — no live app account yet; collect `lane` (+ optional `name`) before Verify OTP
- `isNewUser: false` — returning user; omit `lane` on Verify OTP

**Errors (shared envelope `{ error: { code, message } }`):**
- `422` `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `EMAIL_ADDRESS_INVALID`
- `429` `AUTH_RATE_LIMITED`
- `502` `OTP_DELIVERY_FAILED`

After success, paste the emailed OTP into collection variable `otpToken`, then run Verify OTP.

request.description:
POST /auth/otp/verify — public. Verifies OTP and provisions the app user on first success.

**Request body (JSON):**
- `email` string (required)
- `token` string digits, 6–10 (required) — use `{{otpToken}}`
- `lane` enum `CLIENT` | `STAFF` (required on **first** provision; omit when Request OTP returned `isNewUser: false`)
- `name` string 1–120 (optional)

**Response type:** `application/json`
**Success:** `200`
```
{
  session: { accessToken: string, refreshToken: string, expiresIn: number },
  user: {
    id, email, name, lane,
    roleCode,          // CLIENT → CLIENT; STAFF → STAFF_UNASSIGNED
    staffCode,         // null for CLIENT; string for STAFF
    emailVerifiedAt    // ISO-8601 | null
  }
}
```
**Errors:** `422` OTP_EXPIRED | VALIDATION_ERROR | EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED | LANE_REQUIRED; `409` LANE_MISMATCH; `429` AUTH_RATE_LIMITED.

Tests store accessToken, refreshToken, expiresIn, userId on collection + environment.

request.description:
GET /auth/google/start — public. Starts Google OAuth via Supabase.

**Response type:** HTTP redirect (no JSON body)
**Success:** `302`/`303`/`307`/`308` with `Location` → Supabase `/auth/v1/authorize?provider=google&redirect_to=...`
**Errors:** `503` `OAUTH_CONFIGURATION` when Host/callback config is missing.

Open the resolved URL in a browser. After consent, copy `access_token` **and** `refresh_token` from the callback URL hash into `accessToken` / `refreshToken`, then run Complete Google Auth. Use Auth > Session > Refresh Session when the access token expires.

request.description:
POST /auth/refresh — public. Exchanges a refresh token for a new access + refresh session (rotation).

**Request body (JSON):** `{ refreshToken: string }` — use `{{refreshToken}}` from Verify OTP.

**Response type:** `application/json`
**Success:** `200`
```
{
  session: { accessToken: string, refreshToken: string, expiresIn: number }
}
```
**Errors:** `401` AUTHENTICATION_FAILED; `422` VALIDATION_ERROR.

Tests replace collection + environment `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, and `expiresIn`. Always persist the new refresh token — the previous one is invalidated.

Negative case: malformed email on POST /auth/otp/request.

**Response type:** `application/json`
**Expected:** `422` `{ error: { code: "VALIDATION_ERROR", message: "Request validation failed" } }`

Shared error envelope for all API failures: `{ error: { code: string, message: string } }`. Field-level Zod issues are never returned.

item.name: Gym Orgs
item.description: Create, list, get, and update gym organizations (STAFF / gym admin).

request.description:
POST /gym-orgs — create a gym organization. Requires provisioned STAFF/ADMIN actor (roleCode STAFF_UNASSIGNED or ADMIN).

**Auth:** collection Bearer `{{accessToken}}`
**Request body (JSON):**
- `name` string (required)
- `address` string | null (optional, max 2000)
- `contactPhone` string | null (optional, max 50)
- `contactEmail` string | null (optional email)
- `logoUrl` string | null (optional URL)
- `timezone` string (optional, default `Asia/Kolkata`)

**Response type:** `application/json`
**Success:** `201` `{ gymOrg: { id, name, address, contactPhone, contactEmail, logoUrl, timezone, ownerUserId, createdAt, updatedAt } }`
**Errors:** `401` AUTHENTICATION_FAILED; `403` GYM_ORG_CREATION_FORBIDDEN; `422` VALIDATION_ERROR.

item.name: Staff Invites
item.description: Create, list, inbox, revoke, and accept staff invites via staff_code.

request.description:
POST /gym-orgs/:gymOrgId/staff-invites — invite existing STAFF by staff_code / QR (not email). Admin only.

**Auth:** collection Bearer `{{accessToken}}` (ADMIN at gym)
**Request body (JSON):**
- `staffCode` string (required) — use env `{{inviteeStaffCode}}`
- `targetRole` `TRAINER` | `ADMIN` (required)
- `expiresAt` ISO datetime (optional; default now + 14 days)

**Response type:** `application/json`
**Success:** `201` `{ staffInvite: { id, gymOrgId, invitedUserId, targetRole, status, expiresAt, createdBy, acceptedAt, createdAt, updatedAt } }`
**Errors:** `401` AUTHENTICATION_FAILED; `403` STAFF_INVITE_FORBIDDEN; `409` STAFF_ALREADY_AFFILIATED / STAFF_INVITE_ADMIN_CAP / UNIQUE_VIOLATION; `422` INVALID_STAFF_INVITEE / VALIDATION_ERROR.

item.name: Leads
item.description: Mini-CRM (A11–A13): gym-scoped leads under `/gym-orgs/:gymOrgId/leads`. Requires ADMIN + live gym_admins. Soft warn on duplicate open phone; follow-up date set via Update Lead (not create). A14 convert deferred.

request.description:
POST /gym-orgs/:gymOrgId/leads — capture a lead. Status is always `NEW` on create (`followUpDate` starts null). Soft warn when another open lead shares the same phone — still `201`.

**Auth:** Bearer ADMIN at gym (`{{accessToken}}`)
**Path:** `gymOrgId` — set by Create Gym Org
**Request body (JSON):**
- `name` string (required)
- `phone` string (required, digits)
- `source` string | null (optional, max 255)
- `interest` string | null (optional, max 2000)
- `notes` string | null (optional, max 5000)

**Response type:** `application/json`
**Success:** `201` `{ lead: { id, gymOrgId, name, phone, source, status, interest, notes, followUpDate, createdBy, createdAt, updatedAt }, warnings: [] | [{ code: "DUPLICATE_OPEN_LEAD_PHONE", existingLeadIds }] }`
**Errors:** `401` AUTHENTICATION_FAILED; `403` LEAD_FORBIDDEN; `422` VALIDATION_ERROR.

**Success:** `200` `{ plan }`
**Errors:** `401` AUTHENTICATION_FAILED; `403` PLAN_FORBIDDEN; `404` NOT_FOUND; `422` VALIDATION_ERROR | MEMBERSHIP_PLAN_DELETED.

item.name: Membership Invites
item.description: Stint 1.2 membership invites (A6): Admin create/list/revoke under `/gym-orgs/:gymOrgId/membership-invites`. Requires ADMIN + live gym_admins. Needs an active BASE plan (`planId`). Optional ADDON with TRAINER_COACHING. Client inbox/accept is Phase 3.

request.description:
POST /gym-orgs/:gymOrgId/membership-invites — create a PENDING client membership invite.

**Auth:** Bearer ADMIN at gym (`{{accessToken}}`)
**Path:** `gymOrgId` — set by Create Gym Org
**Prereq:** active BASE plan in `planId` (Create BASE Plan)
**Request body (JSON):**
- `inviteeName` string (required)
- `invitedEmail` string (required; normalized lower)
- `inviteePhone` string (optional)
- `basePlanId` uuid (required)
- `basePaymentStatus` `paid`|`unpaid`|`partial` (required)
- `addonPlanId` + `addonPaymentStatus` (optional pair)
- `expiresAt` ISO datetime (optional; default +14d)

**Success:** `201` `{ membershipInvite }`
**Errors:** `401`; `403` PLAN_FORBIDDEN; `409` unique pending email; `422` invalid invitee/plan/validation.

GET /gym-orgs/:gymOrgId/membership-invites — paginated gym invite list. PENDING past `expiresAt` may surface as computed EXPIRED.

**Auth:** Bearer ADMIN at gym
**Success:** `200` `{ membershipInvites: { items, total, limit, offset } }`
**Errors:** `401`; `403` PLAN_FORBIDDEN.

POST /gym-orgs/:gymOrgId/membership-invites/:inviteId/revoke — PENDING → REVOKED only.

**Auth:** Bearer ADMIN at gym
**Success:** `200` `{ membershipInvite }` with status REVOKED
**Errors:** `401`; `403` PLAN_FORBIDDEN; `404` NOT_FOUND; `409` MEMBERSHIP_INVITE_INVALID_TRANSITION.
